subject: Google My Tag At Your Peril
author: ichienkai
body:
Ichienkai comes from my two of my  favourite Japanese movies: Ichi The Killer and Kichiku Dai Enkai - Its not japanese for gay momohexual fat looser boy Bootleg no matter how many times you tell people! LOL  Ichi means number one and Enkai means battle (or so i thought).  Enkai can mean beast or office party the last time i looked - the strangest translation i have seen is office party for womens clothing which is not that cool for me really....!! Anyway the point is if you google it you get Japanese porn sites ladies and gents (I think they are jap anyway, i promise i have not opened them) - completely unintentional on my part i assure you.  You know what its like when you join xbox live for the first time and you sit there for a long time thinking of a cool tag, or if you are Bootleg you let it generate one for you and get the coolest tag. As he says himself - the tag found me! hahaha

Women and cats will do as they please, and men and dogs should relax and get used to the idea.
